final: WITH per_site AS (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(sp.memusagegb) AS avg_ram, AVG(CAST(sp.procgpu AS REAL) / sp.proccpu) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref WHERE sp.memusagegb > 60.8 AND sp.memusagegb IS NOT NULL AND sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.proccpu <> 0 GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_of_site_avg_ram, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_of_site_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat ORDER BY entrystat
